'''Vaxim''' was a [[Reptavian/Legends|reptavian]] [[Bogwing/Legends|Bogwing]] and the pet of the [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Kasuni Tamm]]. Around the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he accompanied Tamm in her adventures, including the search for a [[Holocron/Legends|Holocron]] at the [[Well of Shadows]].

==Behind the scenes==
Vaxim appears in the introductory story and gameplay example for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[roleplaying game]] book [[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]].
